title: A website editor save and a Space settings save cannot undo each other through the shared preferences blob

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), website cluster review of #3342 and #3377.

detail: FILED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: writeSpacePreferences and the leadership, hero, publish-toggle and menu writers read, modify and write the whole spaces.preferences blob with no lock. An editor autosave (the atomic save_website_editor RPC) landing between their read and write is reverted, and the editor then reports 'Someone saved a newer draft' and drops the autosave. saveWebsiteStyle writes the full blob guarded only on websiteEditor.revision, so it can revert a concurrent menu, hero or overview save. THE FIX: key-scoped writes, for example an RPC set_space_preference(p_space_id, p_key, p_value) using jsonb_set, starting with saveWebsiteStyle.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';if(!fs.readdirSync('supabase/migrations').some(f=>/set_space_preference/.test(r('supabase/migrations/'+f)))){console.error('SCAN-833: preferences writers still replace the whole blob');process.exit(1)}"
